# Billy Andrews

## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, and stolid youth. He has a round, expressionless face and demonstrates a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy Andrews is a big, round-faced youth known for being a dependable, hardworking individual with a good-natured and perpetually smiling disposition. However, he is exceptionally shy and stolid, possessing a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## History

Billy Andrews was given the upper farm in his own name by his father. He later had his sister, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), propose to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on his behalf rather than asking her himself.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P8](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0008)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Billy and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) are brother and sister. The two spent time together when traveling to a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) alongside [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Following the event, they shared the drive home while their companions reflected on the evening and discussed wealth and contentment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), +10 more_

### [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--nettie-blewett.md)

Billy showed romantic interest in [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md), considering her as a potential match for marriage if [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected his suit. Though a marriage between them was reported, the conflicting accounts leave their final marital status unclear.
